title: DevX Initiative: Cohesion Sprint for SDK + Docs Quickstart Rollouts
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Summary: This initiative aligns SDK releases, documentation quickstarts, and onboarding telemetry into a single two-sprint cohesion effort. Goal is to reduce time-to-first-api-call (TTFAC), improve first-run success rate, and create a reproducible rollout cadence for quickstarts and sample apps.

Scope:
- Audit and harmonize the Node, Python, and Go SDK quickstarts so code samples, environment setup, and error messaging match the console UX.
- Ship telemetry hooks and a minimal onboarding dashboard to measure TTFAC, activation, and retry rates by cohort.
- Update docs quickstarts with verified package installation steps, one-click snippets, and a troubleshooting 'first 10 minutes' section.
- Coordinate a staged rollout plan (new signups -> beta orgs -> 10% of active orgs -> full).

Deliverables:
- PRD with acceptance criteria and rollout playbook (Confluence linked below).
- SDK PRs with telemetry and improved readme samples.
- Docs quickstart pages with runnable snippets + unit tests for sample snippets.
- Cohort-based dashboard for activation, time-to-first-api-call, error class breakdowns.
- Post-rollout retrospective and a recommended cadence for future quickstart changes.

Stakeholders: PM (Aisha Raman), Eng leads (Diego Morales, Lina Chen), Design (Priya Nair), DX ops, Analytics.

Out-of-scope: deep runtime changes, new SDK languages beyond node/python/go, enterprise offboarding flows.

Links: PRD, figma mocks, telemetry design, baseline dashboard listed in `links` field.

Risks & mitigations:
- Packaging/signing (ENG-44122): mitigation = temporary installer fallback + docs note.
- Intermittent integration test flakes on macOS for samples: mitigation = isolated CI job + parallel flaky test quarantine.
- Docs slippage: mitigation = frozen content branch and rollout gating by doc signoff.

Notes: This ticket is intended to act as the orchestration/PM record; unit tasks will be split into ENG and DES tickets once scope is finalized.
acceptance_criteria:
1) All three SDK quickstarts (node/python/go) have passing sample-run tests in CI and matching code snippets in docs.
2) Telemetry pipeline shows cohorted TTFAC and first-run success rate for a sample of 500 new signups.
3) Docs quickstart pages include troubleshooting 'first 10 minutes' and one-click copy snippets; UX and copy approved by Design.
4) Staged rollout executed to beta orgs and monitoring shows no >5% regression in API error rate.
5) Post-rollout retrospective notes and recommended cadence published.
success_metrics:
- Decrease median TTFAC from baseline (currently ~7.2m) to < 3m for new signups.
- Increase SDK activation (calls within 7 days) by >= 25% among cohort.
- Reduce sample-code related support tickets by 40% in the 30 days after rollout.
- 95% of sample snippets pass CI runnable checks on first run.
